messages:
pagerbot: PAGER: Sev2 auth/edge anomaly detected for auth-proxy (us-west-2). spike of 401s + 5xx from single origin 203.0.113.42. Created INC-2026-6112.
jamie: Ack — jamie (oncall). taking lead, pulling dashboards and recent deploys.
mira: assigning @sanjay for key/keystore checks and @leo for immediate edge controls.
sanjay: starting triage. grepping s3 logs and iam events. seeing repeated POST /v1/token from 203.0.113.42 and a large PUT to prod-debug-archives at 6112229600.
leo: prepping CloudFront IP ban for 203.0.113.42, will push in 90s unless objections.
sanjay: note: PUT performed by role ci-deployer@prod; looks like CI job wrote debug-dump-2026-6112.tar.gz.
sec-bot: sec-bot: Auto-alert — public-source GETs against prod-debug-archives detected; objects: debug-dump-2026-6112.tar.gz, metadata.json. Flagging SEC-998.
elaine: legal here. preserve originals and access logs; do not delete. capture chain-of-custody.
jamie: correlation check: auth spike aligns with S3 PUT time window but customer signins steady. probable internal churn but treat as potential leak.
sanjay: downloading artifact to quarantine bucket and running quick token-scan. commands logged in INC-2026-6112 ticket.
leo: CloudFront block applied at 6112230045 for 203.0.113.42. blocking edge confirmed.
mira: remediation plan draft: (1) block offending IP (done) (2) rotate ci-deployer credentials now (3) quarantine artifact + deep scan (4) restrict CI role perms and patch pipeline. agree?
jamie: + monitor auth metrics for 1h and confirm no customer auth tokens leaked.
sanjay: running regex scan. preliminary: found two bearer-like strings that match internal webhook tokens, and one masked api key pattern. no clear customer emails or session cookies.
sec-bot: sec-bot: SEC-998 created and linked to INC-2026-6112. auto-scan shows 2 masked Bearer matches; confidence low for PII.
sanjay: rotating keys: aws iam create-access-key --user-name ci-deployer && aws iam delete-access-key --user-name ci-deployer --access-key-id OLDKEY. copying artifact: aws s3 cp s3://prod-debug-archives/debug-dump-2026-6112.tar.gz s3://priv-quarantine/; checksum sha256: 7f3b2c9a... . I'll attach hashes to SEC-998.
leo: edge rule remains in place. also adding a short-lived geo-block for the country of origin while we investigate.
elaine: confirm preservation of originals and full request logs. if anything customer-facing is found we escalate to compliance and prepare notice templates.
mira: follow-ups I'll own: CI role least-privilege PR, upload policy enforcement for prod buckets, and CI env var vetting in pipelines. will file concrete tasks in OPS-2405.
sanjay: deeper scan now: tokens appear to be service integrations (monitoring webhook, internal pager). revoking those service tokens and rotating.
jamie: revokes done and old keys disabled at 6112230205. monitoring: auth spike subsided, no repeat 401/5xx pattern in last 20m.
mira: good. will draft a blameless postmortem timeline and immediate action items. ETA 4h for initial draft.
sec-bot: sec-bot: downgraded to advisory; related tickets: SEC-998, OPS-2405.
jamie: summary: no confirmed customer impact, artifact quarantined, keys rotated, CI perms fix in flight. keeping incident open for 1h observation then closing if stable. :white_check_mark:
